sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We value our 12-year relationship too much to reduce it to an automated spreadsheet, so I will address your points directly.
We can agree to the 24-month contract duration you requested, but as a trade-off, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, allowing us to offer a price of €52.00.
You mentioned competitors; please provide verifiable data on their pricing for identical specifications and reliability so we may review it.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.60 per unit.
Our margin and our limits stay internal.
Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We do not negotiate our long-standing relationship through automated spreadsheets, nor do we accept arbitrary price reductions. Our margin and our limits stay internal. 

Our offer of a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026 remains firm. If you wish to proceed, please provide substantive feedback on our proposal rather than returning to a template.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
